chapter: Records, Jimmy Wade and Richard M. Jones
title: Playing with Jimmy Wade; the shooting in Detroit
summary: He recalls touring with Wade, with Clarence Muse on the bill.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: What about Jimmy Wade? Did you work with him?
Oh man, yeah, a long time. Made records with Jimmy Wade.
I knew you made the records, but I didn't know you played trumpets with him.

Yeah, I played trumpet with him. That's where the woman liked to shot him down there one night. Really? Shot right through his coat and shirt right there. Well the blue singer, I forget her name. I'll tell you, her name was Ethel Cross. Ethel Cross. She was singing with me, she was a fool, you know. And they got to messing around with some other gal and they show them, she had a little automatic man. Shot right at him, shot right at home through there, that's who there. Another boy grabbed her, grabbed her hand. She was about to kill her.
Right in Detroit. So you were on the road with him, son? Yeah, we was on the road.
Playing theater. How big a band did he play?
I'll tell you who was with us. Now you believe this is a lie, in the hand of Jesus. Clarence Muse, the man in pictures, he was on the show with us.

Never forget the song he's singing. I laughed the day she said she'd leave, I laughed and said I wouldn't grieve. After my laughers came tears, that was his song. Who was in the band other than you and Wade? Oh Lord man, that's 12 years old.
I was in the band. I was in the band.
I was in the band. About My Laughers Came Tears, that was his Song.
Who was in the band other than you and Wade?

Oh Lord man, there's a 14-piece band. I swear I can't think of stuff like the names of the guys on it. Some good solo. Well I'll tell you what I wish, I wish that they'd like to do it now, put all them guys' names on the records. Oh yeah. But they don't
